how.title: How I calculate your readiness
how.sub: An estimate from your own numbers. Not medical advice.
how.explain: Each part is worth 70 when you're at your average of the previous 30 days, and moves 20 per standard deviation. Sleep is compared with what Garmin calculated you needed. If a part is missing, the others share its weight.
